segments.text: The dealer gathers the scattered cards with one sweep and squares the deck against the table, watching her settle into the empty chair.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Very little, my lady, for a guest who sits so prettily. Here we play twenty-one, the oldest game in any cellar: come as close as you dare without going over, and the house pays the bold. Name your stake, gold for gold. Or, if counting cards bores you, let fortune settle a round in one stroke. Which will it be?
